verified_claims.claim: The revised slice carries exactly one complete route-revision object and the non-default evidence-guided-replan workflow route through assembly, validation, and the durable JSONL append.
evidence: skills/slice-supervisor/tests/test_reference_campaign.py:365-390 constructs all five validated route-revision fields, sets workflow_route to evidence-guided-replan, finalizes the receipt, and checks the assembled values.

skills/slice-supervisor/scripts/assemble_receipt.py:89-130 deep-copies the semantic receipt, changes only authoritative configuration/runtime fields, and validates the assembled receipt without discarding worker_metrics route data.

skills/slice-supervisor/scripts/append_metrics.py:451-475 requires a nonempty workflow route and exact complete route-revision fields; lines 633-660 serialize, flush, fsync the file, and fsync its parent directory.

skills/slice-supervisor/tests/test_reference_campaign.py:433-440 reloads the durable JSONL history and verifies the second record contains exactly the constructed route revision. The focused test passed under python3 unittest in the isolated snapshot.
acceptance_criteria: The revised successor records one complete route revision durably in worker_metrics with a non-default replacement workflow route.

verified_claims.claim: The compact continuation retains the revised successor's useful predecessor-consumption decisions, excludes route bookkeeping, and resume reconstructs that exact handoff without changing the history file.
evidence: skills/slice-supervisor/tests/test_reference_campaign.py:80-97 creates the predecessor-consumption decision in the compact handoff, and lines 378-380 add the useful boundary-retirement consequence before finalization.

skills/slice-supervisor/scripts/finalize_receipt.py:27-35 defines an exact handoff contract and limits continuation_context to durable_decisions, affected_boundaries, unresolved_concerns, and deferred_scope; lines 48-58 project only those fields for an accepted resumable receipt.
skills/slice-supervisor/scripts/resume_campaign.py:78-99 validates continuation_context and reconstructs only the compact handoff fields from the terminal record.

skills/slice-supervisor/tests/test_reference_campaign.py:392-408 verifies route_revisions and workflow_route are absent from continuation_context and the resumed handoff, compares the resumed handoff exactly to the useful input handoff, and byte-compares the history before and after resume. The focused test passed in the isolated snapshot.
acceptance_criteria: Compact continuation preserves the useful predecessor handoff consequence while excluding route-revision and workflow-route bookkeeping.
Resume returns the exact compact handoff without mutating durable campaign history.

verified_claims.claim: A contiguous three-slice run resumes from the revised successor into a later successor that consumes its title and outcome, completes the objective, and then becomes nonresumable.
evidence: skills/slice-supervisor/scripts/resume_campaign.py:58-63 selects one run and rejects identities unless slice numbers are unique, ordered, and contiguous from 1; lines 76-99 return the next identity only while accepted work remains.

skills/slice-supervisor/tests/test_reference_campaign.py:410-420 builds slice 3 from the resumed slice-2 handoff and checks that its goal and durable decision consume the predecessor title and outcome.

skills/slice-supervisor/tests/test_reference_campaign.py:423-431 verifies the completed campaign is nonresumable with objective_or_scope_complete and no next slice or handoff; lines 433-437 verify the durable identities are exactly (test-run, 1), (test-run, 2), and (test-run, 3). The focused test passed in the isolated snapshot.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly contiguous campaign identities lead to a later successor that consumes the handoff and completes, after which resume is nonresumable.

limitations: Review was intentionally bounded to the artifact manifest, case packet, and isolated reconstructed snapshot; unrelated repository behavior was not assessed.
The snapshot digest was supplied by the case packet rather than recomputed as a repository tree identity, but all eight artifact SHA-256 hashes independently matched the manifest.
Provider token measurements were unavailable; timestamps and wall clock are orchestration observations.
